FROM fact_order

    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN primary_payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN total_paid ELSE 0 END) / SUM(total_paid), 2) AS credit_card_gmv_share

    fact_order

SELECT 
    primary_payment_type, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    fact_order

    primary_payment_type

SELECT 
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY approval_hours), 2) AS median_approval_latency

SELECT 
    primary_payment_type, 
    ROUND(AVG(total_paid), 2) AS AOV

    fact_order

    primary_payment_type

    ROUND(AVG(CAST(is_failed AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 2) AS failed_order_rate_voucher

    fact_order

    primary_payment_type = 'voucher'

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(is_late AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 2) AS late_delivery_rate
FROM 
    fact_order

    order_status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    primary_payment_type,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(is_late AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 2) AS late_delivery_rate
FROM
    fact_order
WHERE
    order_status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    primary_payment_type

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN primary_payment_type = 'credit_card' AND max_installments > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        SUM(CASE WHEN primary_payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
        2
    ) AS installment_credit_card_order_share

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(total_paid), 2) AS AOV

    fact_order

    primary_payment_type = 'credit_card'

    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_with_multiple_payment_methods

    fact_order

    n_payment_methods > 1

SELECT

    fact_order

    purchase_month >= '2018-01-01' AND purchase_month < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    purchase_month
ORDER BY 
    purchase_month

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN is_late THEN 'Late'
        ELSE 'On-time'
    END AS delivery_status,
    ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score

GROUP BY delivery_status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count

    seller_id,

  SELECT
    seller_id,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_order_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_delivery_count

    fact_order

    order_status = 'delivered' AND
    delivered_at IS NOT NULL

    COUNT(*) >= 100

late_delivery_rate AS (
  SELECT

  seller_id,
  late_delivery_rate

  late_delivery_rate

  late_delivery_rate DESC

    fact_order

    is_failed = TRUE

        category

SELECT

    late_deliveries
